shortDescription: Sun, sea, and a sizeable saltwater pool await, in this spacious and bijou setting on the beautiful island of Crete.
longDescription:
Sun, sea, and a sizeable saltwater pool await, in this spacious and bijou setting on the beautiful island of Crete.

Make a spectacular entrance and wow guests arriving by land, sea, or air – with a nearby dock and heli-pad at your disposal. Exchange vows on the water’s edge, flanked by palm trees and just the gentle lapping of calm waters, as you say ‘I do’ in style.

When it’s time to celebrate, there’s plenty of space for entertaining guests, with a 150sqm sea water pool at the focus. It’s an idyllic spot for mesmerising sunsets, with cocktails, aperitifs and good company by your side.

Guests can dine al-fresco and party into the small hours, with on-site catering and hospitality taken care of. As day turns to night, guests need only wander a few footsteps away to retire. The on-site accommodation consists of four luxurious villas for up to 18 guests, with a new villa suitable for 6 guests to be completed by May 2023.

Each property boasts sea views, its own private pool and jacuzzi, and is just minutes from a beautiful private beach. The on-site team can organise further accommodation if required, along with a host of activities to indulge in, from scuba diving to sailing as you discover this iconic Greek island.

Complete with its own wedding planning service, everything is taken care of to ensure your wedding day is as magical as the setting.

For further information on hiring Thalasses Rituals as a wedding venue or to request a brochure with pricing and packages, or book a visit please click here.
highlights: Arrive by speedboat, sip martinis by the pool, and soak up those soothing sunsets – for a touch of James Bond luxe.
todos: The URL slug spells the word "weadding" ("dream-weadding-on-the-beach") — a typo for "wedding". Preserved verbatim as required; the page TITLE and H1 both use the correct spelling "Dream Wedding on the Beach".
META description, og:description and twitter:description are all just the page title ("Dream Wedding on the Beach"); there is no unique SEO description in the source.

The closing sentence reads "...or book a visit please click here." but in the source HTML "click here" is plain text inside a <span> with NO <a href>. The intended destination (brochure / venue-hire enquiry) is missing, so externalLinks is empty and the sentence is a dead end.
The single highlight was taken from the "What we love" label at the end of the body copy; the source has no other bulleted or structured highlight list.

Gallery image URLs in the source markup are the "_thumb.jpg" variants; only the hero/parallax background is available at full size ("...7569639007094f08ba07c7e69f83af08.jpg"). Full-resolution URLs for the other 19 gallery images are not present in the crawled source.
All 20 gallery images share the single caption "Thalasses Rituals - Wedding Venue"; no per-image alt text exists beyond the CMS placeholder "Album Image #NNNNN".
No duration stated anywhere in the source page; duration left null.
No price, rate or 'from' figure stated anywhere in the source page; price left null.

No page-specific call to action exists in the source. The only CTA on the page is the site-wide booking bar ("Book now" -> https://thalassesvillas.reserve-online.net/), which is global chrome, so cta is null.

brokenCta: the closing "...or book a visit please click here." renders "click here" as bare text inside a styled <span> with NO <a href>. This is the site's highest-value enquiry route (wedding venue hire, brochure, pricing, site visit) and it goes nowhere.

STALE CONTENT: the body copy states "...with a new villa suitable for 6 guests to be completed by May 2023." Kept verbatim as required, but the date has long passed — the client must confirm whether the villa exists, and the sentence must be rewritten or removed before republishing.

sectionLabel "What we love" is an on-page bold sub-heading (font-weight: 700 <span>) that introduces the highlight sentence. It was dropped in the previous pass and is restored here; it is the only sub-heading anywhere in the 21 experience pages.

wordCount 288 was recounted directly from source (7 body paragraphs + the "What we love" label + the highlight sentence; H1, the 20 album captions and site chrome excluded). An earlier working figure of 292 could not be reproduced from either the readable text export or the raw HTML.
categoryProposed is an editorial grouping added for the redesign; the live site has no categories — confirm with the client.
